name: Cairo 1
typeSystem: Static, strong, Rust-inspired type system (structs, enums, traits, generics) layered on top of Cairo's underlying field-element (felt252) primitives, with linear types ensuring certain resources (like builtins) are used exactly once - far safer and more expressive than Cairo 0's bare assembly-like style.
runtime: Compiles down through Sierra (a safe intermediate representation that guarantees provable execution) to Cairo assembly (CASM), executed by the Cairo VM to produce a trace for STARK proving, as used by StarkNet.

runtimes.name: Cairo VM (via Sierra → CASM)
runtimes.role: Executes CASM compiled from Sierra, producing an execution trace consumed by a STARK prover; StarkNet's execution layer.

compilers.name: cairo-compile / scarb
compilers.role: Compiles Cairo 1 source through Sierra to CASM; Scarb is Cairo's package manager and build tool.

concurrencyModel: N/A (single deterministic execution trace, later proved and verified; no concurrency).
